info.title: API.SH: Transfermarkt
info.description: The Transfermarkt API from API.SH: public Transfermarkt data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A club: names, abbreviation, country, league, parent club with address and colours, squad size, average age, total/average/top-18 market value and acquisition value, former names, and the squad with each player's profile, position, contract, market value, shirt number and captaincy.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/transfermarkt-club

parameters.name: club_id
parameters.description: Transfermarkt club id (11 = Arsenal FC, 131 = FC Barcelona).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A club's squad for a season: every player with position, shirt number, captaincy, date of birth, age, nationalities, height, foot, date joined, club signed from (with the fee text), contract end date (current season), market value and the profile link. Choose any season back to the club's early years.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/transfermarkt-club-squad

parameters.name: club_id
parameters.description: Transfermarkt club id (418 = Real Madrid, 11 = Arsenal FC, 131 = FC Barcelona).

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season start year (2022 = 22/23). Default: the current season.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A club's arrivals and departures of a season: player, position, age, nationalities, the other club and its league, the fee (or loan), and the season's expenditure, income and balance.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/transfermarkt-club-transfers

parameters.name: club_id
parameters.description: A club id or club link.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season start year (e.g. 2024 for 24/25; default the current season).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A competition: name, country, current season, game days, total market value, logo, and its table (position, previous position, club, played, wins, draws, losses, goals for/against, difference, points, qualification zone) for the current or a past season. Pass `include=fixtures` (or `matchday`) for the fixtures and results, `include=clubs` for every club with squad size, average age, total and average market value, acquisition value, colours and its stadium (name, city, capacity, boxes, seats, standing room), and `include=stadiums` for the stadium list alone.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/transfermarkt-competition

parameters.name: competition_id
parameters.description: Transfermarkt competition id (GB1 Premier League, ES1 LaLiga, IT1 Serie A, L1 Bundesliga, FR1 Ligue 1).

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season start year (default: current).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `fixtures`: also return the season's fixtures and results by matchday (date, home and away club, score, finished or live, attendance, stadium and referee ids, link). Costs one more upstream request. `clubs`: every club with squad values and stadium, sorted by market value. `stadiums`: each club's stadium with city, capacity, boxes, seats and standing room (leagues; cup competitions have no stadium list, so their stadiums are null). Comma-separate several.

parameters.name: matchday
parameters.description: Only this matchday's fixtures (implies include=fixtures).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The latest confirmed transfers with the site's filters: player, position, age, nationalities, from and to club (with country), date, market value and fee (or loan/free). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/transfermarkt-latest-transfers

parameters.name: competition_id
parameters.description: Only transfers involving clubs of this competition.

parameters.name: country_id
parameters.description: Only clubs of this Transfermarkt country id (189 = England).

parameters.name: min_value
parameters.description: Minimum market value in EUR.

parameters.name: max_value
parameters.description: Maximum market value in EUR.

parameters.name: min_fee
parameters.description: Minimum fee in EUR.

parameters.name: max_fee
parameters.description: Maximum fee in EUR.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page (25 per page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A football manager's profile on Transfermarkt: name, full name, date of birth and age, place of birth, citizenship, coaching licence, average term, preferred formation, agent, the linked player profile, portrait and the career history (club and id, role, appointed and until dates, matches, points per match).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/transfermarkt-manager

parameters.name: manager_id
parameters.description: The manager id (4), or a manager link like transfermarkt.com/<name>/profil/trainer/4.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The most valuable footballers in the world as Transfermarkt ranks them: rank, player and id, position, age, nationalities, club and id, market value (number and text) and profile link. 25 per page, up to 20 pages.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/transfermarkt-market-value-ranking

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 to 20 (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A match from Transfermarkt: date, season, matchday, competition, attendance, score and how it ended, both sides' formation, coach, squad value, starting line-up and substitutes (position, shirt number, age, market value), team statistics (shots, passes, set pieces...), every event (goals, cards, substitutions) with players and minutes, and the referee and officials.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/transfermarkt-match

parameters.name: game_id
parameters.description: A Transfermarkt match id or match report link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A player's profile (birth date and place, nationalities, height, foot, positions, contract until and last renewal, agent, outfitter, current/previous/highest market value, image), club assignments with shirt numbers, full market value history (date, value, club, age) and transfer history (date, season, from and to club with competition, fee, market value at the time, loan/transfer type, pending moves) with totals. Pass `include=injuries` for the injury history and `include=social` for the player's social media links (network and link).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/transfermarkt-player

parameters.name: player_id
parameters.description: Transfermarkt player id (from `/transfermarkt/v1/search` or a profile URL; 433177 = Bukayo Saka).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `injuries`: also return `injury_history` (season, injury, from and until dates, days out, games missed, clubs affected; the latest injuries listed first). Costs one more upstream request. `social`: also return `social_links` (each network the profile links to, e.g. x, instagram, tiktok, facebook, with its link; null if the page could not be read). Comma-separate both.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A player's game-by-game record summed per season and competition: squad calls, appearances, starts, minutes, goals, assists, own goals, penalty goals, yellow and red cards. With `games=true` every game too (date, competition, matchday, opponent, venue, result, participation, minutes, goals, assists and the full statistics block).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/transfermarkt-player-performance

parameters.name: player_id
parameters.description: Transfermarkt player id (from `/transfermarkt/v1/search` or a profile URL; 433177 = Bukayo Saka).

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season start year (2023 = 23/24).

parameters.name: competition_id
parameters.description: Only this competition (GB1 Premier League, ES1 LaLiga, CL Champions League ...).

parameters.name: games
parameters.description: true adds the game-by-game list.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A player's injury history: season, injury, from and until dates, days out, games missed and the clubs he missed them for. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/transfermarkt-player-injuries

parameters.name: player_id
parameters.description: A player id or player link.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A referee's profile on Transfermarkt (name, date and place of birth, citizenship, first league debut) and record by competition: appearances, yellow cards, second yellow cards, red cards and penalties, with totals. All seasons by default, or one season and competition.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/transfermarkt-referee

parameters.name: referee_id
parameters.description: The referee id (1157), or a referee link like transfermarkt.com/<name>/profil/schiedsrichter/1157.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Starting year of one season, e.g. 2025 for 2025/26 (default: all seasons).

parameters.name: competition
parameters.description: A competition id such as GB1 (default: all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search players (position, club, age, nationalities, market value, image), clubs (country, squad size, market value) and managers, with the number of hits per type. Pass `next_page` back as `page` for more players; null on the last page. A name written first-initial-first ("G. Donnarumma") that finds nothing is searched again as last name and initial, and `searched_as` shows the text that matched; a search with no hits answers empty lists.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/transfermarkt-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of player results (10 per page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
